title: Fort Robinson: Outpost on the Plains

The author details the political dynamics among the Sioux, their alliances, and the fluctuating sentiments towards the U.S. government, offering readers a glimpse into the struggles faced by Agent Saville as he navigates the challenging landscape of Indian relations.
